caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers with a reddish-brown finish. The chest consists of two main stacked sections, with the top section being larger and taller than the lower portion. The top of the chest features a decorative, curved pediment with three finials, one at the center and one at each outer end. The upper section contains four main drawers, with the top drawer divided visually into three sections. In the middle of the uppermost section, there is a carved fan or shell motif. Each drawer has two ornate metal handles, likely brass, with a pale yellow-green hue. The lower section of the chest has two small drawers at the top, side by side, and a large drawer below with another carved fan or shell motif in its center. The chest stands on four cabriole legs, each ending in a pad foot, and features subtle decorative scalloping along the bottom edge. The entire piece is rendered against a plain light beige background, and there is a small, cursive signature or annotation in the lower left corner.
title: Highboy
